text:
ishan_cs: Quick thread 8: Beacon Systems (pilot) sent a feedback bundle after onboarding day 10. Need product triage so CS can update renewal playbook.

ishan_cs: Customer short asks pasted below:
```
1) Per-campaign billing breakdown (finance needs cost per campaign/route)
2) Embeddings export with exported-row timestamps + retention filter
3) On-prem nightly sync (air-gapped validation)
4) Console first-run wizard + sample prompts for common workflows
5) Per-route rate limits and soft-quota alerts for noisy routes
6) Tagging SLA labels on model endpoints (for enterprise contracts)
```

maya_pm: Which items are blocking their pilot / renewal?

ishan_cs: #1 and #3 are blockers; #6 is critical for legal sign-off but not immediate payment-blocking; #2/#4/#5 are high-value ops improvements. Renewal in ~4 weeks; finance flagged billing visibility as urgent. :rotating_light:

oliver_prod: One-line impact notes: #1 -> prevents correct invoicing and campaign ROI reports; #3 -> compliance/legal can't approve deployments; #6 -> required for contract clause, delays procurement; #2 -> saves analysts 15+ hrs/month; #4 -> reduces first-week support load; #5 -> prevents noisy-usage bill shock.

nic_eng: Rough engineering t-shirt estimates: #1 (campaign billing) -> 2 devs x 4-6w (usage pipeline + billing model change). #3 (on-prem nightly sync) -> 3 devs x 6-9w (packaging + infra). #6 (SLA tags) -> 1 dev x 1-2w + minor Console UI. #2 (embeddings export w/ timestamps) -> 1 dev x 2w. #4 (wizard) -> 1 designer + 1 dev x 2w. #5 (rate limits/alerts) -> 1 eng x 2-3w.

maya_pm: Prioritize by revenue/legal risk: 1 > 3 > 6 > 1/2/5/4 (I'll translate to roadmap scores). Can CS offer interim mitigations?

ishan_cs: Offered a daily CSV billing split and a signed attestation for on-prem testing as short-term mitigations. Customer said CSV is painful but usable for up to 5 weeks if we give a firm commit date.

cs-bot: Created RD-4720: "Beacon: campaign billing interim export + RFC" assigned to @nic_eng.

nic_eng: I'll add an API-first spike for #1 to avoid immediate Console work and try to shave 2 weeks. Will capture acceptance criteria in RD-4720.

maya_pm: Please add Impact/Effort on the roadmap board: #1 Impact=9 Effort=8, #3 Impact=8 Effort=9, #6 Impact=7 Effort=2, #2 Impact=6 Effort=2, #5 Impact=5 Effort=3, #4 Impact=4 Effort=2.

ishan_cs: I asked Beacon to rank their internal list 1-6 and confirm CSV acceptance. Will paste reply here when it comes in.

nic_eng: If customer confirms, we can start spike for #1 next sprint and parallelize SLA tagging in a small PR.

maya_pm: Action items: ishan -> get written acceptance of CSV and customer ranking; nic -> add API spike to RD-4720; maya -> update roadmap and schedule 30m grooming.

ishan_cs: Beacon replied: ranking = 1,3,6,2,5,4 and they accept the CSV interim if we commit to a delivery window within 3 weeks. Renewal risk = "medium-high" if #1 not committed.

maya_pm: Thanks team. Treat #1 as immediate priority. Closing thread until RD-4720 has a spike plan. :white_check_mark:
